slides.title: Bitcoin just went quiet. Here's what came next before
slides.sub: Volatility, explained with 5 years of real prices.

slides.title: What volatility means
paras: Volatility measures how much a price swings. Higher = bigger daily moves, up and down.
Bitcoin's 30-day volatility is <g>23.5%</g>, close to its 2026 low of 21.9% in August. Still more than double the S&P 500.
slides.source: Hotcoin calc. from Yahoo Finance daily closes (BTC-USD, gold futures, S&P 500)

slides.title: One year of swings
paras: After February's sell-off, Bitcoin's volatility peaked near <r>85%</r> in early March.
<u>Now it's one of the calmest stretches of the year.</u>
slides.source: Hotcoin calc. from Yahoo Finance BTC-USD daily closes

slides.title: Quiet spells don't last
paras: Since 2022, Bitcoin had 14 quiet spells like this one (volatility under 32%). Here's what the price did in the next 30 days:
slides.source: Hotcoin calc. from Yahoo Finance BTC-USD daily closes

slides.title: Up or down? A coin flip
paras: In 9 of the 14 quiet spells, Bitcoin moved <g>10% or more</g> within 30 days.
But the direction split almost evenly: <u>6 times up, 8 times down</u>.
slides.source: Hotcoin calc., Yahoo Finance BTC-USD, Oct 2021 – Oct 2026. Past patterns don't predict future moves.

slides.title: How traders use it
paras: Low volatility is a warning to prepare, not a signal to bet:

items.t: Set stops <g>before</g> the move, not after
Don't guess the direction from calm alone
